info.name: Azure Site Recovery REST RecoveryPlans ReplicationProtectedItems API

description.content:
Azure Site Recovery REST API provides management of disaster recovery for
Azure VMs, on-premises VMs, and physical servers via Azure Resource Manager.
Supports configuring replication, running test failovers, executing planned
and unplanned failovers, and managing recovery plans on Recovery Services
vaults. Authentication uses Azure AD OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens.
